description: Qwen3-0.6B direct SFT: CE / KD / WCE from one shared untrained LoRA, merged SFT+post-training inputs, joint-budget alternating training.

execution_deviations.decided: 2026-10-19, before the formal run, with explicit owner approval
execution_deviations.reason: The rented RTX 4080 SUPER was latency-bound at microbatch=4 (3.4 s/step, ~15% GPU utilization). Identical data measured 1.7 s/step at microbatch=8 and 0.84 s/step at microbatch=32.
execution_deviations.impact: All three arms use the same value. Effective batch stays 32, the loss is still averaged over the actual rows in each batch, and sample order, seeds, learning rate, schedule and evaluation positions are unchanged. Only the gradient-accumulation granularity differs, which changes floating-point association but not the estimated mean gradient.

selection: max tune macro-F1, tie -> max tune nDCG@10, tie -> earlier step

fusion.rule: equal-weight probability fusion on the 5,230 lowest student max-probability rows (SHA256 tie-break); teacher abstention falls back to the student; T alone counts abstentions

evaluation_policy.sets: tune selects checkpoints; gate and F are evaluated only after the models are fixed; both are existing development sets, not new independent tests
